text:
alex: FYI onboarding Atlas-Embed-2.1; legal clause looks messy. The model page includes: `License: CC-BY-NC-4.0` but a special embedding addendum says 'embeddings may be used commercially with attribution to upstream'. Anyone seen this pattern? I want to confirm whether we can host a quantized variant in Dedicated and serve embeddings commercially.

sam: @alex can you paste the exact clause? NC usually blocks commercial use of the model weights, but there are often exceptions for derived artefacts like embeddings—need to see language.

alex: pasted snippet:
```
Section 4(b): "Embeddings derived from the Model may be used for commercial purposes provided attribution is given to the original model and dataset owners; redistribution of modified weights or model binaries is prohibited."
```
Does that permit hosting a quantized binary in our Dedicated offering (customers pay us to host) or is that redistribution?

maria (ml): My read: serving embeddings is usually OK, but shipping quantized binaries (e.g., .pt/.bin) to customers or S3 is redistribution. Can we keep the quantized binary on our infra and only expose embeddings via API? That should be safe.

devon (platform): Operationally we can keep the model inside Dedicated and only expose embeddings via API. But if a customer requests model export (for on-prem), we'd need explicit rights.

sam: Agreed. Two action items: 1) ask licensor for clarifying amendment permitting commercial serving of quantized weights in hosted/dedicated contexts (not redistribution), 2) add Attribution badge and manifest in response payloads and docs. We should also have a fallback plan: if licensor denies, refuse to host quantized binary for paying customers or use a permissive alternative.

yana (solutions): For customers who insist on local hosting, we need to decline or route them to a 'research-only' plan. Also update onboarding checklist.

alex: attaching link: https://models.example.org/atlas/embed/2.1/license and license text in thread. Will file request with licensor today. Thanks all :pray:

sam: Thx. I'll draft a short amendment template we can send. Ping me if they ask for attribution format. :thumbsup:
